first_herbs.name: Roots of Cultivation
first_herbs.desc: Elder Mo wants five Spirit Herbs. They grow at the village edge and in the warrens' damp corners.

warrens.name: Thin the Warrens
warrens.desc: Goblins have dug into the old dungeon under the village. Kill their chief on Floor 1.

crypt.name: Rest for the Dead
crypt.desc: Below the warrens lies a crypt that will not stay quiet. Put down the Bone Lord on Floor 2.

mine.name: The Drowned Seam
mine.desc: The old silver mine on Floor 3 flooded, and something still works it. Break the Foreman Golem.

sanctum.name: The Warden Below
sanctum.desc: Floor 4 is where the nanites came from. Their Warden is corrupted. End it.
